editor_indicator_hint.message: Choose a circle, square, triangle, or custom PNG. Status colors and blinking apply automatically.

editor_image_hint.message: Static PNG · up to 2 MiB and 2048px per side. Switching between the original image and solid fill preserves the original.

editor_background_hint.message: Image X/Y starts at the top-left of the output frame. Content outside is cropped; uncovered areas stay transparent. Source images and transform history are not included in the ZIP.

editor_off_hint.message: This element is off. Turn it on to edit its preserved settings.

editor_font_error.message: Check font name, size and color. Sizes must be whole pixels from 8 to 32.

editor_atlas_error.message: Images do not fit in one PNG atlas. Reduce the input image dimensions.

editor_pair_error.message: PNG and JSON do not match. Select the correct pair.

editor_pair_hint.message: Select a theme ZIP, or the matching PNG and JSON files.

editor_png_hint.message: Use a static PNG up to 2 MiB and 2048px per side.

editor_json_hint.message: JSON files must be at most 64 KiB.

editor_file_error.message: Could not process the theme or image. Existing edits are kept.

editor_changed.message: Changes applied. Export to save the files.

editor_reset_done.message: Editor reset to the default theme.

editor_open_done.message: Theme opened. Off components absent from the files start from defaults.

editor_initial_hint.message: Select an element in the preview or list. Select characters / status messages directly in the preview.

editor_navigation_hint.message: Ctrl + wheel: zoom at cursor · Space + drag: pan · Click empty space: deselect

editor_select_hint.message: Select an element in the preview or the list below.

editor_adaptive_color_hint.message: Primary, secondary and line colors adapt to light/dark mode. Custom colors stay fixed.

editor_zip_error.message: Use a ZIP exported by the theme editor. The current work is kept.

editor_semantic_color_hint.message: The existing adaptive color is preserved until you change the color value.

editor_frame_hint.message: Fixed 256 × 640px output frame. Image positions start at its top-left; anything outside is cropped.

editor_image_bounds.message: Use integer positions from -16384 to 16384px and image sizes from 1 to 16384px.

editor_source_size.message: Use a static PNG up to 2048 × 2048px and 20 MiB. Final theme PNGs must stay within 2 MiB.

editor_background_handles.message: Drag the image or its handles. Off-frame handles stay on the frame edge. Edges snap within 6 screen pixels.

editor_transparent_icon_hint.message: Remove image keeps the icon area transparent. Turn off its text component to use the icon area as the action button.

editor_export_preview_hint.message: Review all background stages and the home screen. Choose Save file to download the ZIP, or return to editing.

editor_placement_background_hint.message: Shared by all conversation stages, above the main background and below components. X/Y start at the top-left of the 256 × 168px placement area; anything outside is cropped. Its visibility is independent of the main background. The original default decoration adapts its line color to light/dark mode; solid fill uses your chosen color. A new PNG uses its original colors. Exporting the default decoration alone preserves its adaptive color; merging it with a main picture fixes colors to the current preview. A regular theme ZIP stores the merged image. When both backgrounds are present, an optional recovery ZIP can reopen the two layers separately within their cropped frames.

editor_help_adjust.message: Adjust its image, text, size and position.
